name: get-record
description: Gets one HubSpot contact, company or deal by id, with its main properties and the ids of its associated contacts, companies and deals. A contact id comes from hubspot__find-contact, a deal id from hubspot__find-deal, and a company id from a contact's or deal's associations here. Answers found: false when no record has that id.

recordId.description: The record's id: a contact's from hubspot__find-contact, a deal's from hubspot__find-deal, a company's from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.
